title: chrysanthemum japonense
intro: Chrysanthemum japonense, commonly known as Japanese Chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to East Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum japonense include its sedative and anti-anxiety effects, which can help to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
